verdict.rationale: Navan's MCP server lets an AI assistant answer questions about policies, approval flows, and flag/decline reasons, including why a transaction was flagged and which policy applies. Ava also compares spend to company policy and answers T&E questions, which covers explaining declines and policy Q&A conversationally. Missing for 10: any evidence of an assistant proactively chasing missing receipts, explicit pre-spend "can I expense this?" guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the conversational enforcement.
